mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4/CYP2C9 inducer that may reduce disulfiram levels, while disulfiram inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing eslicarbazepine metabolite accumulation and CNS toxicity.
action: Monitor for reduced disulfiram efficacy and increased eslicarbazepine-related CNS adverse effects; consider therapeutic drug monitoring if available and adjust dosing accordingly.
